_meta.name: context7
_meta.description: Context7 — injects up-to-date library documentation into agent context. Critical for fast-moving libraries (Next.js 15, shadcn, Supabase JS, Stripe). Eliminates hallucinated/outdated API patterns.
_meta.note: No API key required. Usage: mention 'use context7' or include 'C7' in your prompt to pull current docs for the library you're referencing.
